batting.name: T Kohli
batting.dismissal: c M Manhas b GD McGrath

batting.name: M Kaif
batting.dismissal: c B Geeves b R Bhatia

balls.text: fires in a slow yorker, Salunkhe makes room and digs it back to McGrath
strides down and heaves, getting an inside-edge down to deep square leg
makes room and drives hard to extra-cover for a single
well bowled, right up there in the zone, and Salunkhe drives to midwicket
walks way outside off and attempts it again, but cannot connect
nicely done! Salunkhe just walks across the stumps and scoops it over Karthik
shuffles around, Vettori keeps it flat and he biffs it down to long-on
makes room and misses out on the cut, cleverly disguised ball
good use of the feet, and a clean smash over long-off, makes for a top shot
short one is cut past cover, and a diving stop allows the four
again tossed up and this one's past midwicket, Salunkhe sends him back
tosses it up on middle and leg, Trivedi plays it towards mid-on
another short one outside off gets Salunkhe ducking low, so its a dot ball
slower delivery again, Trivedi picks it and chops it into the covers for one
good short one, sitting up and skimming past the bat as he gets tall
slower ball on off stump, Trivedi backs away and chops to cover
takes his eyes off the bouncer and it nearly takes his head off
goes for a booming drive over extra-cover, gets a thick inside-edge onto the back leg and it proceeds to roll onto the base of his stumps, dislodging the bails
fails to put the short and wide one away, instead cutting towards point
comes forward and clips this one past midwicket
another arm ball, which is played to backward point rather well
uses his feet and goes aerial, good shot but just the single
oh ho ho ho, Warne also tries the cheeky shot as he shows all his three stumps and very narrowly gets bat on the arm ball, chopping to point
cheeky shot, opening the face and dabbing to a fumbling gully fielder
another firm shot between square leg and midwicket, cut off by a sliding Bhatia who covers ground in the deep and receives the bowler's applaud
bang! Warne produces a short-arm jab to the shorter ball, clearing the front leg and clubbing it over midwicket
good length ball, moves in and Warne plays it to midwicket
that one beats point, and McGrath on the ropes, as Warne cuts harder
gets a shorter one and tries to run past point but the fielder is sharp
straight on middle and leg, Warne tries to on-drives but cant beat the field
single to end the over, Warne also turning one past midwicket
tosses it up down leg and Salunkhe clips it out to the deep for one
fuller one, drifting into leg stump, Warne again tries to flick and gets an inside-edge wide of Vettori's left hand
slides down leg stump, Warne misses out on the flick to midwicket

but this is Vettori, and he's been around for a while now! The wily veteran fires it in fast and flat and Jadeja, exposing the stumps in an attempt to steer it away, fails to get bat on it much to Vettori's pleasure ...smart bowling after being carted for six
great shot, man! Jadeja dances down and heaves this one over mid-on
hits a short length and gets Salunkhe hopping up to keep the ball down
again he backs away miles to leg stump, this time gets some bat on it with an ill attempt at a pull, very cramped, so thats good stuff from Geeves
tries to get cheeky, exposing the stumps, but cannot make contact
full down leg stump, he clips it down to Vettori at fine leg
gets forward and pushes this one into the gaps
now there's a shot and a half! Jadeja creates room and goes over point
gives himself room and drills this one down to the man at long-off
comes forward and drives a single into the covers
good stuff, no room to work with and the ball is just turned to midwicket
pitches well wide of the stumps, Karthik fumbles so thats a couple
slower ball on the stumps and Salunkhe on-drives for a single
thats an intellectual edge, Salunkhe opening the face and sneaking it past Karthik's gloves down to the third man fence
cleaned up! Rawat goes attempting one of those en vogue paddle-sweeps, but fails to make any contact whatsoever and pays the price for exposing leg stump
thinks about stepping out but Vettori fires it in and he defends to cover
comes onto the front foot and pushes to backward point for one
well bowled, flighting it on middle and off and Rawat smothers the spin
looped up on off stump and he pushes into the covers for a single
smart batting, as he gets back and late-cuts the flatter, shorter one away
and thats clobbered rows back over long-on! Jadeja greets Vettori by slogging him with the turn and a firm strike gets him maximum
sees the fuller length and slogs it to down to long-on for one
some room on offer and Jadeja cuts it to the man at backward point
comes forward and plays a good-looking drive to cover for a single
simple as can be! A struggling Kaif reaches across and paddles the ball from just outside off stump straight into the hands of Geeves at short fine leg
full on off stump and Kaif just drives it back to Bhatia
slower delivery, Kaif shuffles but cannot work the ball past midwicket
overpitched and Kaif plays a firm on-drive for a single
whats he doing? The ball is short and Jadeja backs away to leg, again copping one on the body ... he looks all at sea, honestly
low full toss which Kaif drives down to Geeves at long-off
full outside off, Jadeja uses his feet and drives to mid-off and Gambhir, on the circle, misses the stumps
full and straight and Kaif clips it to mid-on for one
short outside leg stump, Jadeja tries to get out of the way but cops it on the elbow and the ball runs to square leg, and the umpire signals leg-byes
gets up and punches a shorter one past cover for a single
flicks a straighter one uppishly to the fielder at midwicket, didn't carry
comes onto the front foot and drives a full one into the covers
swing and miss, attempting a booming cover-drive, Karthik lets it go for byes
a touch fuller but young Jadeja can only drive it to the cover fielder again
back of a length and Jadeja punches off the back foot to cover
back of a length on off, tapped towards point and he calls for it, and Kaif is let off going for the risky single as the throw misses the stumps
this one's short and down leg stump, the 'keeper collects and appeals, but I'm not sure for what exactly

and the big man goes! Lehmann shuffles across and tries to turn a straight one past square leg but misses, and even before Maharoof can complete his appeal umpire Pratapkumar shoots up the finger, it pitched on leg stump and looked out, though Lehmann didn't think so
good line and length and Kaif can only push it to cover
flowing square-drive from Lehmann, creamed past point for one
too straight and he works that away towards square leg, but off the pads
punches a good-length delivery to mid-off and keeps strike
an action replay of sorts, except this ball sits up, and well taken too
plays and misses from his crease, good seam positioning
stands and punches this one past point and Lehmann has some running to do
Watson slogs the slower ball over cover and it drops in no man's land, but attempting a tight run he has to go on his way, Bhatia accepting a good flat throw at the nonstrikers' end
hits a good length and Watson opens the face to steer towards point.
scrambled seam beats Kaif's bat as he inches forward and tries to run it away
another yorker, played out towards Bhatia at mid-on, good bowling
drifts onto the pads, Kaif misses but scampers a leg-bye at Watson's urging
hits a good length and Kaif defends well to cover, but thats not a shot you want
change of pace squares him up and he ends up edging towards gully
he drives from the crease and drags it towards midwicket, hit too hard
now there's a yorker, and very well dug out to midwicket by Watson
top delivery, nipping in off a length and Watson tries to run it fine but gets cramped, the edge falls well in front of the slip and wicketkeeper
stays low but he pulls the short one into the ground and the ball races away through the gap at midwicket and across the turf
thats too straight, and Kaif gets off the mark with an uppish shot in the air past a diving midwicket
another inside-edge as Kaif just tries to drive from the crease, with zero footwork, and survives as the ball takes bat then back leg
short of a length and zipping into the ribs, he tries to work it fine but instead plays it towards point
thats four, as he clips a full one off his toes past a diving short fine leg

gone! short outside off, pulled away and they take a most reckless single, Manhas gets an accurate throw and Geeves does the rest, there was some hesitation in the running and that was suicidal from Yusuf. Needs to run back all the way. Third umpire is called up and that's gone.
clattered down the ground towards long-off
on middle and leg, turned away delectably for four, rips through short midwicket
driven crisply to short extra cover but that's a fine save from Shikhar Dhawan, but he tried to throw down the stumps and made a mess of that one, runs away for four overthrows
quick outside off, tapped towards cover for a single
leaves this one outside off and thats the first maiden in the IPL
straighter one and Watson turns it towards square leg
lands it on a length and it moves past the bat again, top bowling this
gone! Kohli decides to take on McGrath by skipping down but only succeeds in swiping the ball to Manhas at midwicket, who takes a simple catch
this one's closer to the stumps and Kohli tries to nibble it fine but misses
lands it on that same length, Kohli pushes and misses it
another slash, this time over backward point, evades a diving sweeper
stands and flashes with no footwork and gets a french-cut to fine leg
comes onto the front foot and squeezes this one down to third man
drives from the crease and the away swing beats the bat again
there's some bounce, the ball beating Pathan's limp bat outside off stump
back of a length and Pathan defends the ball to point
now thats smashed, as Kohli advances and creams the ball over cover-point
beaten again as the subtle movement passes by the bat
he's like a machine, McGrath, pitching on that lovely length and the extra pace and bounce beats Kohli as he fishes for it from his crease
first runs come courtesy a wide outside off, Kohli charges down but misses
oh ho, that very nearly knocked back the base of off stump as Kohli inside-edges a drive but looks back as the ball misses its mark, theres some movement out there
similar line as the ball wobbles off the seam and beats Kohli's slash
thats an expected channel from a man who retired after the World Cup, on the dime outside off stump with a hint of movement and Kohli leaves it be
flat down leg stump and with that flick off the pads comes victory by nine wickets and a deserved half-century to Dhawan
there's a front-foot defensive to point, as Gambhir decides to give Dhawan a shot at hitting the winning runs and raising his half-century
dropped in short, he pulls out to deep midwicket to move to 48
dances down and swings this one over Trivedi's head for four, firm shot
heaves this one and though its mistimed he gets a couple past mid-on
short, stays low but Dhawan pulls from outside off and past square leg
again he errs in line and Gambhir turns him off the hips to fine leg
very short outside leg stump, batsman misses and wide is called
back of a length, hint of movement in, punched off the back foot to cover
more room and Gambhir drives it out to Pathan at deep cover
banged in short and Dhawan pulls, making sure to keep it down, through the gap at midwicket and out to Trivedi in the deep
goes for a square-drive, chopping into the ground at point and running hard
short and quick, the extra bounce beats him as he goes for a pull across the line
too much width and Dhawan slaps it out to the deep cover fielder
short outside off and Dhawan drags it into the gap at midwicket and mid-on
rubbish delivery, slides way down leg stump and the 'keeper can't get there
outside off and Gambhir gets onto the toes to punch into the covers
again the wrong line, Dhawan clips it past mid-on to keep runs ticking over
short down leg stump and Gambhir works it into the gap for one more
short again, Dhawan waits and pulls out to the sweeper as well
terrible ball, just too short and Gambhir pulls out to midwicket sweeper
tries to convert it into a low full toss but inside-edges onto his pads
comes onto the front foot and pushes this one straight to point
full down leg stump and he turns it past square leg with ease
there's his fifty to rapturous applause, cutting a wide one past point and he walks down to punch gloves with Dhawan ... a fluent innings from Gambhir
full on middle and leg, he plays against the turn and clips to midwicket
flat on middle and leg, Gambhir shuffles and pushes to midwicket
uses his feet and drives the flatter one down to Munat at long-off
a touch too short outside off, spins in and Dhawan cuts past point too
flat on off stump, he makes room and steers this one past point
too short and he plays a short-arm jab through the gap at square leg
gets some width and cuts towards the man at backward point
dances down and drills this one to mid-off, very firmly struck
comes forward and drives the ball just wide of the gap for one
full on the stumps, he drives but cannot beat the fielders
quicker one foxes Dhawan, who edges wide of the 'keeper and leg stump

dropped! Gambhir plays another booming drive in the air, very hard and Warne sticks out his left hand but cannot clutch on to it at cover ... he had very little time to react and did well to take some pace off the bat
the Gambhir special, reached out and driven on the up firmly past cover
spins sharply down the stumps and a wide is called, 'keeper fumbles
short and wide, cut hard but its that man Kaif at backward point, well done
looks to come forward, then waits and tucks it past square leg
this time he connects but under-edges the topspinner wide of leg stump
flatter trajectory and Dhawan cannot connect on the square cut
shot! Flighted up on middle and leg and Dhawan firmly sweeps very fine
a tad fuller and Gambhir paddles from off stump with the spin, into the gap
legbreak on the stumps, Gambhir tucks it straight to midwicket
this one lifts sharply and he tries a cheeky glide over the 'keepers head, but misses
shuffles across and turns the ball from off stump through midwicket, sprinting hard and diving to make his ground as a high throw comes back in, and thats the 50-run partnership
a bit too full and Dhawan picks the vacancy, thumping it over Trivedi's head
now thats fielding! Dhawan cracks a back-foot cut but an acrobatic Kaif flings himself around at point and saves a certain four
slower ball slips out and ends up very wide outside off stump

poor fielding out in the deep, after Dhawan short-arm-jabs one past square leg ... can you guess who it is? Its Munaf Patel, not know for his work in the field .. he got down lazily and allowed the ball through his grasp
short of a length on middle and leg, an easy nudge through midwicket
bouncer there, Gambhir almost takes his eyes off it but plays it with one hand into the gap in front of midwicket and Dhawan urges the quick single
short on the stumps and Dhawan pulls down to the man at fine leg
this one's wide outside off, Dhawan slashes and misses and then looks up to umpire Aleem Dar, who remains unmoved ... a marginal call
good slower ball, just pushed off the front foot uppishly to cover
short on leg stump and he coolly turns it past square leg for a single
decent delivery on off stump but Dhawan pushes into the covers
well done, a yorker on middle and leg and Gambhir turns it to midwicket
top shot, first advancing and then hooking the bouncer down to fine leg
short and wide and Dhawan slashes hard but the ball just evades Kaif's fingers at backward point
he too goes for a pull but only finds the man fielding at short fine leg
looks to make room but the change of pace draws an inside-edge past leg stump
thats a wide, well down Gambhir's thigh pad
short one outside leg stump, Gambhir tries to pull but cant make contact

and he's dropped! Attempted yorker, Gambhir comes forward and loses a hand off the bat as the ball balloons up into the covers, where Watson dives forward to his left, cups the ball, but loses control as he hits the ground ... a single is pinched to boot
comes down and misses hitting the full one, the 'keeper collects
very well played, as Gambhir kneels down and gently glides the ball between the yawning gap from the wicketkeeper and slip, the crowd goes berzerk
now there's a shot! Gambhir sashays down and lofts it over extra-cover for six
very wide and Dhawan reaches out, slapping it into the covers, he loses his bat but runs down and just makes his ground, leaping out of the ball's way
pushes forward and drives it across the line, Munaf sticks a hand out to stop
slower ball on a shorter length and he steers it to Warne at wide slip
creams the cover off this one with a booming extra-cover drive, bang!
better length and he gets forward, driving to the cover fielder
good shot, Dhawan connects on a short-arm jab over midwicket
fuller one outside off and Dhawan drives fluently to mid-off
short outside leg stump and Gambhir pulls down to fine leg for one
short of a length, another back-foot punch but Warne stops it at point
flashes a back-foot cut straight to the man doing duty at point
comes down the track, Munaf holds back the length and Gambhir can only get a single into the covers
gets cramped playing a pull and the ball flies towards mid-off, but falls safe
smoked! Gambhir makes room and slashes over deep point for four
slower ball, Gambhir drives but the edge falls short of slip, close call
ripper, kicking off a length and beating Dhawan, who flirts at it
bad ball, sliding down leg for a wide as it beats the bat
angled across the stumps and he leaves it be watchfully

and he's gone! Watson strikes back with a big wicket, as Sehwag stands his ground and plays a nothing shot to one back of a length, only playing the ball off the inside-edge onto pad and then the stumps as the fans are numbed
make that three in row! Sehwag opens the face of the bat and places that superbly between the wide first slip and the 'keeper and the Kotla goes ballistic
clubbed! Sehwag pulls that from outside off stump and the ball screams away past midwicket before the fielder could move
and he just hammers this one straight over Watson's head, wasn't a bad ball but it was in Sehwag's zone and he launches it for four
top shot, a terrific straight drive just pushed downtown past mid-off
firm stroke, just slashing the full one past Warne at point, and thats four
dances down and drives hard but misses completely on the booming shot
tidy delivery on off stump, he stands his ground and pushes to point
goes to cut and edges it but it falls well in front of the wicketkeeper
full outside off and Gambhir square-drives straight to backward point
